meta.description: The actors become the directors and bring the play to its climax.

units.rawText: We defeat the Entropic that is impersonating Love, and it shrivels into dust before vanishing.

Are you feeling better?

units.rawText: I will NEVER let them seize my neural cloud...
units.displayText: I will NEVER let them seize my neural cloud...

spans.text: I will NEVER let them seize my neural cloud...

units.rawText: Our efforts have paid off. Nothing can be more heartening to see. Welcome back.

spans.text: Our efforts have paid off. Nothing can be more heartening to see. Welcome back.

units.rawText: ...You actually saved me from my Tertiary Level. I should apologize for almost giving up on you earlier.

With a wave, Wisdom directs the Lesser Sanctifiers to spread out around us and stand guard.
Then, she reaches a hand toward the purple fissure.
A pure white glow appears in her hand.

units.rawText: <color=red>Ah... The dragonslayer becomes the dragon in the end. No matter what the hero might wish for, the ending will never change. This is undoubtedly a tragedy.</color>
